title: Tumatuma App
description: Engineered the mobile banking and remittance platform enabling diaspora users in the UK to complete cross-border money transfers. Features a modular architecture using BLoC concurrency, Veriff identity verification (KYC), and real-time WebSockets.

title: Momento
description: Android-first event planner. Discover live events from Ticketmaster, add them to your phone's calendar, and use AI to shorten or translate an event's description (English, French, Swahili) before saving. Saved events open offline and sync when you're back online. Backed by a separate Node/Express API that handles auth, caching and AI, with the app's API types generated from its OpenAPI spec.

title: Chakula Search
description: Smart food search for restaurant menus. Customers search the way they talk, in English, Swahili or Sheng, and get matching dishes with a one-line reason for each. Claude turns the query into structured filters, Postgres enforces allergens, diet and price in SQL so a nut dish can never match "no nuts", and pgvector ranks the rest. Includes an admin dashboard and a search-insights page for the owner.

title: Nafusite Jewellery Store
description: Freelance client project: a responsive React and Firebase e-commerce store with a self-service admin dashboard, delivered in three months. It took the business online for the first time and is still maintained and supported.

title: SpendWise IQ
description: Privacy-first expense tracker. Pick a receipt photo and the app reads the vendor, date and total on-device, suggests a category, and lets you confirm before saving. Offline-first with no account, optional biometric lock and monthly summaries. In active development: camera capture and exports are next.
